decks.notes: The main concept of this deck revolves around using Stitcher's Supplier and Grisly Salvage to fill the graveyard quickly, then using Eldritch Evolution to sacrifice creatures and bring out powerful cards like Parhelion II, Greasefang Okiba Boss, and Skysovereign, Consul Flagship. The deck also includes ways to disrupt the opponent's hand with cards like Thoughtseize and Can't Stay Away. The mana base is optimized to support the various colors needed for the deck's powerful creatures and spells, with key lands like Boseiju, Who Endures for protection. Overall, the deck aims to quickly assemble a powerful board state and overwhelm the opponent with its combo potential.

This Selesnya Aggro deck focuses on aggressive creatures like Resplendent Angel, Righteous Valkyrie, and Youthful Valkyrie to quickly overwhelm the opponent. It also includes cards like Skyclave Apparition and Collected Company to control the board and maintain pressure. The deck utilizes mana ramp with cards like Bishop of Wings and Nykthos, Shrine to Nyx to ensure consistent and powerful plays. Overall, this deck aims to establish a strong board presence early on and leverage synergies between its creatures to close out the game quickly.

This deck focuses on aggressive creatures and efficient removal spells to quickly overwhelm the opponent. It utilizes powerful creature cards like Werewolf Pack Leader, Reckless Stormseeker, and Lovestruck Beast, supported by mana accelerants like Elvish Mystic and Llanowar Elves. The deck also includes versatile removal spells such as Obliterating Bolt and Bonecrusher Giant to deal with threats from the opponent. The inclusion of cards like Esika's Chariot and Lair of the Hydra adds additional value and flexibility to the deck's game plan. Overall, this deck aims to apply constant pressure and control the battlefield to secure a victory.

The main concept of this Gruul Aggro deck is to establish early board presence with efficient creatures like Bonecrusher Giant and Lovestruck Beast, supported by ramp spells such as Llanowar Elves and Elvish Mystic. The deck aims to apply pressure quickly and close out the game with powerful finishers like Skysovereign, Consul Flagship and Reckless Stormseeker. The inclusion of cards like The Akroan War and Obliterating Bolt provide additional removal options to clear the way for attacks. Overall, the key strategy is to overwhelm the opponent with a fast and aggressive gameplay style.

The main idea of this deck is to overwhelm the opponent with a combination of evasive creatures and powerful spells, focusing on tempo and aggression. By using Azorius Spirits and Snow-Covered Islands, the deck aims to control the board and disrupt the opponent's strategy while steadily increasing its own threats. Cards like Curious Obsession and Ascendant Spirit offer card advantage and pump up the team, while cards like Slip Out the Back and Shacklegeist provide removal and disruption. The deck's key strength lies in its ability to apply pressure while maintaining control of the game.

This deck focuses on ramping up mana quickly with cards like Llanowar Elves, Nykthos, and Wolfwillow Haven to play big green creatures like Cavalier of Thorns and Old-Growth Troll. It utilizes Kiora, Behemoth Beckoner to draw cards and Karn, the Great Creator to search for key artifacts. Storm the Festival helps find more threats while Lair of the Hydra provides a powerful additional win condition. The deck also includes some versatility with cards like Nicol Bolas, Dragon-God and Boseiju, Who Endures to handle various situations.

The deck focuses on overwhelming the opponent with a swarm of low-cost creatures and protecting them using spells like Brave the Elements and Thalia, Guardian of Thraben. It also utilizes synergies with cards like Luminarch Aspirant and Thalia's Lieutenant to pump up the team and push through damage efficiently. The inclusion of cards like Skyclave Apparition and Adeline, Resplendent Cathar provide some extra flexibility and power to deal with threats and close out games quickly. The deck aims to maintain pressure and control the board to secure victory.

The deck focuses on utilizing lifegain synergies with cards like Righteous Valkyrie and Bishop of Wings, while also using powerful creatures like Skyclave Apparition and Resplendent Angel to apply consistent pressure on the opponent. The addition of Collected Company allows for quick deployment of creatures onto the battlefield, while Nykthos, Shrine to Nyx provides additional mana ramp to help cast multiple spells in a turn. Overall, the deck aims to overwhelm the opponent with a combination of lifegain, aggression, and efficient creature deployment.

The main concept of this deck is to quickly build up devotion to green in order to ramp up mana with Nykthos, Shrine to Nyx and overwhelm opponents with powerful green creatures and spells. The deck focuses on aggressive plays and utilizing cards like Llanowar Elves, Elvish Mystic, and Wolfwillow Haven to accelerate mana production. Cards like Karn, the Great Creator and Storm the Festival provide additional value and options, while creatures like Old-Growth Troll and Cavalier of Thorns offer strong threats on the battlefield. The deck is designed to quickly establish board presence and put pressure on opponents.

This deck focuses on quickly ramping up mana and assembling the combo pieces of Greasefang, Okiba Boss and Parhelion II to create a powerful board state. Using cards like Grisly Salvage and Satyr Wayfinder to fill the graveyard and find key pieces, along with cards like Eldritch Evolution to search for specific creatures, the deck aims to overwhelm the opponent with a strong army of tokens and flyers. Additionally, cards like Can't Stay Away and Raffine's Informant provide extra value and protection for the combo pieces.

This Selesnya Aggro deck focuses on quickly developing a board presence with creatures like Youthful Valkyrie, Righteous Valkyrie, and Resplendent Angel, while also using cards like Collected Company to maintain pressure on the opponent. The deck includes cards that support the aggro strategy, such as Skyclave Apparition for removal and Bishop of Wings for added defense. Additionally, the deck includes lands like Temple Garden and Branchloft Pathway to ensure consistent mana production for efficient plays. Overall, the deck aims to overwhelm opponents with a fast and aggressive strategy.

This deck revolves around ramping up mana quickly through cards like Arboreal Grazer and Lotus Field to cast powerful spells like Emergent Ultimatum and Omniscience. The key strategy is to tutor for key combo pieces using Fae of Wishes and Mastermind's Acquisition, while also having the ability to protect them with cards like Boseiju, Who Endures. The deck focuses on combining different cards to create powerful synergies and win conditions in order to outpace and overwhelm the opponent.

This deck focuses on flooding the board with low-cost, aggressive creatures to quickly overwhelm the opponent. It utilizes cards like Thalia, Guardian of Thraben and Brave the Elements to protect its creatures and disrupt the opponent's strategies. By constantly applying pressure with cards like Adeline, Resplendent Cathar and Luminarch Aspirant, the deck aims to deal damage efficiently and close out the game before the opponent can stabilize. Castle Ardenvale and Mutavault provide additional utility and flexibility in combat. It relies on synergy and speed to achieve victory.
